biggest_catch: Your friend must make 20 total card purchases of at least $10 each — 10 in the first 30 days and 10 more in the next 30 days — for either of you to earn the $75. That's a high spending bar; if your friend doesn't hit every purchase, nobody gets paid.
catches: Friend must open share savings + checking accounts, get a debit card, and make 10 purchases of $10+ in the first 30 days and 10 more in the next 30 days (20 total).
Referral info must be provided via the online form, in a branch, or by phone BEFORE the friend opens their account.
Referring member and friend must be 18+; members must be in good standing to collect.
Business, HSA, and rep-payee accounts ineligible; employees, volunteers, and household family members don't qualify.
Payout processed within 32 days of completing all requirements, deposited to share savings.
Tax treatment not stated; treat as potentially reportable income.
Promotion subject to change or cancellation without notice.

steps: Refer a friend (not a current Empower FCU member) through the online referral form on the page, in a branch, or by phone — BEFORE the friend opens their account.
Your friend opens a share savings account and a checking account, and gets a debit card.
Your friend makes 10 purchases of at least $10 in the first 30 days, and 10 more in the next 30 days (20 total).
You and your friend each receive $75, deposited to your share savings accounts within 32 days of completing all requirements.
